notes:
ALL 8 WIs DONE, each staged (git add api/ docs/ CLAUDE.md) with its tests green before the next. NEVER committed. Web/.claude untouched by me (web/ files in the index were staged by the parallel web agent).

D1 (A1): ONE migration AddReportIndexesAndFleetLogo — up-SQL = 1 nullable ADD COLUMN (fleets.logo_updated_at) + 4 CREATE INDEX, zero DROP (verified non-destructive). Added ONLY genuinely-new indexes: orders(fleet_id,driver_id,created_at), orders(fleet_id,status,created_at), order_events(fleet_id,at), audit_logs(fleet_id,at) — orders(fleet_id,created_at) already existed (did not duplicate). SuperAdmin/System enum members + policies + Fleet.PrimaryColorHex + FleetSettings self-service cols all pre-existed (no re-add).

D2 (A2): SQL per-Prague-day aggregation via Database.SqlQuery with (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Prague')::date GROUP BY + COUNT/SUM FILTER. NO ToList-then-group. Hours-online = separate window-clamped driver_shifts query merged in memory (GetMySummary pattern). CSV = pure DriverReportCsv (no FastEndpoints/CsvHelper), UTF-8 BOM+';'+CRLF, Send.BytesAsync. Fixture DriverReportExpected.csv byte-compared; api/.gitattributes marks *.csv binary so CRLF survives CI checkout.

D3 (A3): SQL KPIs (COUNT/SUM/AVG FILTER, EXTRACT(EPOCH) for time-to-assign/pickup, cancellation_rate). SMS count = NotificationLog.Channel==Sms in window * FleetSettings.SmsUnitCostCzk. Rides-per-day = 2nd SqlQuery Prague-day GROUP BY. Top routes = LINQ GroupBy+Join (translates). 50k seed = ReportSeedScript (raw INSERT…generate_series, idempotent, NOT demo seeder, [Trait Category=Perf] — excluded from normal suite via --filter "Category!=Perf"). Perf test warms once then times the 2nd hit <300ms.

D4 (A4): .Concat() UNION-ALL of order_events+audit_logs projected to one AuditRow shape, OrderByDescending(At).ThenByDescending(Id).Skip().Take() — translates to SQL (spike-confirmed, no fallback needed). jsonb Payload/Diff NEVER projected; order codes resolved via a separate in-memory id→code dict. orderCode filter resolved to an order id up-front. Tenant auto-scoped by both entities' query filters.

AMENDMENT A8 (HIGH): DELETE /customers/me loads orders via IgnoreQueryFilters().Where(o=>o.CustomerUserId==sub) — customer JWT has no fleet_id so the null-tenant scope also lets the anonymize SaveChanges bypass the tenant guard (cross-fleet orders). SMS code validated against user.Phone mirroring VerifyCode (SHA-256 hex, not expired/used, attempts<5). Orders anonymized (kept), refresh_tokens+push_subscriptions+user deleted. Pinned by DeleteMe_OrdersRemainInReportsAnonymized (fleet report still counts the anonymized order).

AMENDMENT A5 (the one cross-tenant write): POST /admin/fleets is SuperAdminOnly; sets CurrentTenant.FleetId=newFleetId before SaveChanges so the guard stamps the new tenant's FleetSettings/Tariff rows (DevelopmentSeeder technique). Duplicate-slug lookup + ListFleets use IgnoreQueryFilters. Returns one-time BCrypt password once (never logged). CLI = SuperAdminBootstrapper + Program.cs args intercept (create-superadmin --email --password) that migrates, runs bootstrapper, returns BEFORE app.Run(). MANDATORY AdminFleets_Create_NonSuperAdmin_Returns403 green.

AMENDMENT A3 (ratings): GetRatings is explicitly rangeless (EndpointWithoutRequest, no request type) — documented in the endpoint summary.

AMENDMENT A6 (logo): UploadLogo guards are ENDPOINT guards (IFormFile via Files, no FluentValidation) — >200KB→400 FleetLogo.TooLarge, non-PNG(magic-byte check)→400 FleetLogo.NotPng, missing→400 FleetLogo.Missing. Storage root configurable via FleetLogo:StorageRoot (default /data); test factory points it at a temp dir (TaxiApiFactory.LogoStorageRoot).

NEW TRAP (recorded in CLAUDE.md): EF Database.SqlQuery<T> maps result columns by the property's snake_case configured name — alias columns AS "card_czk" not "CardCzk" or it throws 'required column card_czk not present' → HTTP 500. EF.Functions.AtTimeZone does NOT exist in Npgsql 10 (CS1061); use raw AT TIME ZONE in FromSql.

SQL-aggregation approach: both reports server-side; audit merge in LINQ. 50k seed gating: [Trait Category=Perf], run final suite with --filter Category!=Perf. CLI bootstrap: args[0]=='create-superadmin' intercept after builder.Build(), return before app.Run().

post_review_fixes: Two advisor findings closed after the first green pass: (1) DeleteMe AC coverage + atomicity — the refresh-token/push-subscription deletion was never seeded/asserted (both ExecuteDelete calls hit 0 rows in every test, so the AC was untested); now seeds one RefreshToken + one PushSubscription and asserts both are gone after 204. Also converted the removals from immediate ExecuteDeleteAsync to tracked RemoveRange so they commit in the SAME SaveChanges as the order anonymization — GDPR erasure is now atomic (no partial-delete window). (2) 50k perf test is now opt-in via RUN_PERF_TESTS=1 (Assert.Skip otherwise), so a plain `dotnet test` (the DoD gate; no CI workflow exists yet — that's assignment 08) never seeds 50k on the hot path nor flakes on a raw wall-clock budget on slower hardware. [Trait Category=Perf] retained for filter selection.
